oracleMovementReview.reason: Reviewed the complete 16-shard native macOS 26 arm64 cohort at Chromium 147 and source e1e8a604. The old baseline covered 234 stacks and 5850 codepoints per stack under synthetic v1; the new cohort covers 351 stacks and 292466 assigned codepoints per stack under synthetic v2. Expanded stack/codepoint sampling changes Chrome face counts by millions, so the old distribution is not comparable. The 8366768 measured route mismatches are retained as a regression baseline and tracked for root-cause repair in DM-Q9BAAJ.
